:::{#exm-partial-pooling-blp}
#### Mean squared errors for Aitkin County

Use the estimates from @exm-radon-shrinkage as if they were the true values:
$\sigma_\alpha^2 = 0.0886$, $\sigma^2 = 0.587$, and $n_j = 4$,
so $\sigma^2 / n_j = 0.14675$.
By @lem-partial-pooling-blp,
$\text{MSE}(c) = (c - 1)^2 \cdot 0.0886 + c^2 \cdot 0.14675$:

| Predictor | $c$ | $\text{MSE}(c)$ |
|---|---|---|
| Complete pooling | 0 | $0.0886$ |
| No pooling | 1 | $0.1468$ |
| Partial pooling | $0.0886 / (0.0886 + 0.14675) \approx 0.3765$ | $\approx 0.0552$ |

The partial-pooling weight matches the $w_j \approx 0.377$ of @exm-radon-shrinkage,
and its mean squared error is smaller than that of either extreme.
:::
